'''Kasper Melinga Hidden Base EBO''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Kasper Melinga]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls52.htm Hidden Base EBO], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040717135338/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls52.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kasper Melinga]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
